clusters.canonical_title: Alternative derivation pathway for "12" exponent / d_spec probe in mu_BC (heat-kernel + zeta-at-interior-s* + rep-theoretic)
clusters.rationale: Items 24, 25, and 162 all propose the same three-route derivation pathway (heat-kernel small-t expansion, interior zeta critical point, rep-theoretic decomposition) for the d_spec / "12" exponent in mu_BC = M_Z*sqrt(1 + exp(12*tau_fold)/3). Item 24 (feynman) frames it as alternative derivation of the cube-3 coefficient; item 25 (tesla) replaces the W9b-105 boundary-dominated zeta probe with the same three routes; item 162 (tesla) is the mu_BC geometric-pin alternative using the same three methods if cube-3 stays closed. Same inputs (D_K eigenvalue cache L_max=10, zeta scan, SU(3) Wigner-Eckart / rep-theoretic tables), same three-route machinery, same target observable.

Items 72 (tesla) and 74 (mack) are verbatim duplicates: apply .claude/templates/mellin-balance-pre-declaration.md to all 16 enumerated S84 cluster-test gate blocks, re-dispatch W6-71 audit, lift compliance_fraction 0.0 -> 1.0, add saturated-balanced subclass for zero-cluster gates. Identical inputs (W6-71 template + audit script + 16-gate enumeration) and identical remediation scope.
